name: CodePet
author: Greyforge Labs
description: Your CodePet on the bar: a pet to feed and play with that cheers on your coding apps (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Hermes, Grok) and grows from their finished work. One On/Off switch.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: name shows the pet's name next to its picture; none shows only the picture.

schema.label: Count active time
schema.description: Needs change only during active time while this widget is on your bar and you are at the computer.

schema.label: Pet on my desktop
schema.description: Show the desktop pet when the bar loads. Let's go! turns it on; More switches it.

schema.label: Calm mode
schema.description: Less motion: no pulsing badge or tiles and no animation loops in the popup.
